elements.text:
You have an assignment due next week that your professor and many of your classmates are going to see. You aren't completely comfortable with the material and worry about how the assignment will go.

Here are some behaviors that someone might do at that moment or in the future:

texts: I'll pretend to be sick on the due date so I don't have to do the assignment.
I want to work on the assignment instead of going to sleep for the night, but I realize it's important to get rest.
I don't want to tell my family about how difficult this assignment is, but decide to tell them anyways.
I'll set aside time every day to work on the assignment.
I'll ask my friends with expertise in this area questions if I don't understand something.
